items.company: Mach - Banco de crédito e inversiones
items.description: Actively collaborate in multidisciplinary agile teams, integrating critical features into the Mach application. Currently, I'm implementing technical solutions under Clean Architecture and Kotlin, working hand-in-hand with Product and Backend teams to ensure seamless integration of financial services.

Worked with the Research and Development team to create native Android applications linked to specialized hardware. Integrated Bluetooth and IoT communication protocols for real-time health data monitoring.
Integrated into critical-phase projects, contributing to maintenance and development of new features for a diverse client portfolio. Collaborated on incident resolution and performance improvements.
Developed a functional prototype of a social impact application focused on teaching reading to adults through mobile accessibility. Executed integration of voice recognition and audio command APIs.
